description: Renovation and Reconstruction Court Buildings at Point Pedro and Batticaloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-05-04
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, for the reconstruction of the buildings of the above Courts at a cost of Rs.51,936,991.50 and Rs.96,881,368.02, was approved by the Cabinet to be implemented in 2012.
